From the manufacturer

Meet the 1900 ScanSmart Laptop Backpack

Pack all of your gear and then some in this extra-roomy, full-featured laptop backpack. Made from durable ballistic polyester, this backpack makes airport security a breeze with it’s ScanSmart lay-flat capability, all while holding a 17” laptop and a 10” tablet.

Goes everywhere

The ample storage space won’t hold you back. This backpack was designed for everything your travels throw at you. It’s even specially designed to fit the under-seat space of most major US airlines.

All-day comfort

Airflow ventilation back panels ensure a cool and comfortable trip. And with straps designed for everyone 5’ 4” to 6’ tall, you always experience the easiest carry.

The ultimate carry (it) all

Effortlessly move from bedroom to boardroom and back. This backpack can carry it all with ample organization pockets and compartments. Easily stow and carry everything you see.

Sail through security

With our lay-flat ScanSmart technology, your backpack passes through TSA security without removing your laptop or tablet.

Stay protected. Always.

Keep your cards and data secure in the front organizer’s RFID-blocking pocket — built for cards, passports, keys and more.

Go ballistic.

Our 1200D ballistic polyester is built to stand up to the most rugged conditions.

Ultimate carry-on combo

An add-a-bag trolley strap allows you to lock the backpack onto your favorite carry-on.

  • Will a 17-inch laptop fit?

    Yes — the padded ScanSmart compartment holds up to a 17-inch laptop, with a separate sleeve for a 10-inch tablet beside it. At 31 liters, there is room for the rest of your day too.

  • Can I get through TSA security without taking my laptop out?

    Yes. The ScanSmart compartment lies flat at the checkpoint, so the bag goes through the X-ray belt without removing your laptop or tablet.

  • Will it fit under the seat as an airline personal item?

    It is designed to fit the under-seat space on every major US airline as your personal item, and it rides as a carry-on in the overhead bin.

  • Is it comfortable when it is fully packed?

    Yes. Airflow back panels keep you cool and the padded straps are shaped for all body types, so a full load still carries easily.

  • How durable is it, and will it last?

    The body is built from high-denier, abrasion-resistant polyester and put through 25+ quality tests — engineered to hold up to years of daily carry and travel.

Product Description

The SWISSGEAR 1900 is the backpack that handles the full workload. Built from 1200D polyester, it carries the laptop, the tablet, the documents, the extra clothes, and the daily essentials without compromising structure or comfort. The ScanSmart lay-flat compartment keeps laptops up to 17" in the bag through TSA screening; a dedicated TabletSafe™ pocket secures tablets up to 10" x 7"; and a document divider in the main compartment keeps paperwork flat and accessible. At 3.2 lbs empty, it carries everything without weighing you down. Organization and comfort run deeply throughout this design. The RFID-protected front compartment holds cards, a removable key/fob clip, and the small items that need to stay put. A trolley strap slides over luggage handles so the pack rides hands-free between gates. Contoured shoulder straps and an Airflow back panel manage heat and load distribution across long travel days or commutes, while compression straps stabilize the pack when it's full and a reinforced molded top handle handles the quick grabs. Backed by SWISSGEAR's 5-year limited warranty.

    What is your backpack purpose? Repeat customer for Swissgear products
    This is my favorite brand of computer backpack. My household has been using this brand for over 20 years. For many years they were used daily. The inner liner on the tiny pocket of my previous 20 year old backpack finally tore so I purchase this one as a replacement. Mainly used for travel and anyplace I have to tote a laptop too. So far, things are going well. I will update if that changes. Material and workmanship: Sturdy and quality. I understand sometimes there can be defects and I would hope they stand by their warranty. So far all is good. Size: This is a good size. Small enough to fit under an airline seat, big enough to hold the essentials. I use mainly for all types of travel. I can fit a change of clothes, medications, umbrella, bose headphones, airpods, water bottle, snacks, wipes, tissues, etc. I travel with a macbook air always and sometimes a heavy lenovo laptop. It holds both. Pockets and design: This is a slightly different design than my last one. I went with this one because it was on sale. For the overall purpose ( to haul all my stuff around,) it serves the purpose. I kinda wish I spent a little more and got the similar model I had before. -The laptop compartment has a padded velcro adjustable strap. I do not know if this is necessary but it is there. It is removable. Compartment is roomy enough to hold 2 laptops. This compartment only has a "one side" zipper. It does not zip all the way around. I found this a little annoying since my last one had a zip around. I am sure I will adjust to it but I prefer to pull my laptop out of the top instead of out the side. The downfall of one zipper, you can not zip tie or put a lock on the zippers. Depending on where we were traveling, we would zip tie the zippers. It does have a tiny pocket on the top. Not quite sure what I would use that for. - Next compartment for a tablet. It is padded around the sides and has mesh in the middle. This one unzips all the way around. TSA friendly design. Have not tried this out with two laptops yet so I don't know how that will go with tsa. The tablet pocket is small so maybe ipad mini size? The ipad pro would not fit. They could have designed this to be bigger. I was thinking of getting a laptop sleeve and using this compartment for my macbook air when I travel with 2 laptops. - main compartment: has a mini pocket for phone but I use for my airpods. Has a divider for books, papers or whatever. I actually use it for wipes. Can fit a change of clothes in a packing cube, medications, headphones, snacks and everything I need. There is a mesh zipper pouch on the top. This is great for cords or whatever. - top front pocket- I have a love hate relationship with this one. Easy to empty your pockets and phone into when going through tsa but a pain to get stuff back out. You have to dig around a little. I will probably need to separate things in little bags to make this pocket work for my needs. I miss having a small top pocket for things like chapstick and eye drops. Making two pockets, iphone sized and a small one for little things, would have been my ideal solution. - bottom front pocket: this one is fine. Big enough for epipen, inhaler, key hook, hand sanitizer, tissues, gum, some toiletries, misc stuff. Also has some loops on outer part of pocket. - side zipper pockets: there are small size zipper pockets on each side that are deep. These are ok. Weird shape. Can fit a small umbrella or a standard plastic water bottle. Space for other things but I don't have that many skinny long things going in a backpack. Pocket is deep so if you wanted to put money or something way down at the bottom of this pocket, this would be hard for anyone to just grab out of your bag. You can not fit a water bottle or similar item in the mesh pockets on the outside of these ones if there is stuff in the pockets. - mesh stretchy water bottle pockets: The pockets are a little small. These can hold a smaller sized water bottle. There is a strap to help secure. It would be better if there was a loop at the top to hook a carabiner on it, to secure a water bottle. I have lost a water bottle before out of this pocket. Sometimes I use the strap to tie a sweatshirt or raincoat to it. Backpack Straps: padded, thick work well. Have a few loops for whatever. Back is padded enough. Comfortable enough to carry around for a few hours. Overall, a good backpack. When shopping for a backpack, think of your purpose and what you want to put in it. Does it have the right sized pockets for your needs? The price was right for this one and I will use it until it breaks.

      Great slim bag with a weird laptop holder
      Reviewed in the United States on July 29, 2026
      Size: 18.5-InchColor: Navy Ballistic
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I spent more time than I would care to admit looking for a solid backpack, but good ones are expensive and I didn't feel like buying a few to try then return. I wanted a backpack for my office job to carry my tablet, laptop, work binders/folders, blender shaker bottles, and small knick-knacks to and from work and between different offices. These were my requirements:

      - Holds my laptop in a sleeve (preferably padded/protected)

      - Tablet sleeve big enough to hold my Kindle Scribe Colorsoft

      - Stylish and slim with plenty of room

      - Good quality without breaking the bank

      - Side water bottle cup holders with straps to hold down my insulated blender bottle shakers

      - Plenty of pockets for smaller items (gum, chargers, charging blocks, pens, etc.)

      - Something I could use for an overnight or couple day trip

      I hated it for the first 20 minutes I owned it because I thought it did not have a general large interior compartment area with folder dividers as shown in the product images. However, I quickly realized the zipper track blended in too well with the bag and I simply missed it (it's right in front of the larger top handle).

      This backpack nailed it. Even the tablet compartment hold my kindle scribe securely, though I'll likely only use that when traveling as it's a tad too snug. The only thing I don't care for is how the laptop compartment is only a side entrance zip and the "sleeve" is a plush arm that secures the laptop in place with velcro that you have to remove and reattach every time you move your laptop in it. That seems a bit odd and is slightly tedious to do, but I assume it's for easy access; they should really include that in the pictures of the product. Also, I understand that the backpack essentially zips in half to open up 180 degrees for quick airport security laptop checks, but I almost never fly, so that may be useless to me. I've read other reviews that claim the bag opens up on its own because of this feature. I've only had it a week so far but that hasn't happened to me yet and I don't see how it would unless the bag was packed full and only partially zipped shut.

      Overall I love this bag, it meets all of my requirements and then some. It also redistributes the weight well due to its longer size, so more weight in the bag somewhat feels like less. Highly recommend.

Highly recommennd the brand as a whole.

    • an amazon customer
      5 out of 5 stars
      What is your backpack purpose? Repeat customer for Swissgear products
      Reviewed in the United States on June 5, 2026
      Size: 18.5-InchColor: Black/Grey
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This is my favorite brand of computer backpack. My household has been using this brand for over 20 years. For many years they were used daily. The inner liner on the tiny pocket of my previous 20 year old backpack finally tore so I purchase this one as a replacement. Mainly used for travel and anyplace I have to tote a laptop too. So far, things are going well. I will update if that changes.

      Material and workmanship: Sturdy and quality. I understand sometimes there can be defects and I would hope they stand by their warranty. So far all is good.

      Size: This is a good size. Small enough to fit under an airline seat, big enough to hold the essentials. I use mainly for all types of travel. I can fit a change of clothes, medications, umbrella, bose headphones, airpods, water bottle, snacks, wipes, tissues, etc. I travel with a macbook air always and sometimes a heavy lenovo laptop. It holds both.

      Pockets and design: This is a slightly different design than my last one. I went with this one because it was on sale. For the overall purpose ( to haul all my stuff around,) it serves the purpose. I kinda wish I spent a little more and got the similar model I had before.

      -The laptop compartment has a padded velcro adjustable strap. I do not know if this is necessary but it is there. It is removable. Compartment is roomy enough to hold 2 laptops. This compartment only has a "one side" zipper. It does not zip all the way around. I found this a little annoying since my last one had a zip around. I am sure I will adjust to it but I prefer to pull my laptop out of the top instead of out the side. The downfall of one zipper, you can not zip tie or put a lock on the zippers. Depending on where we were traveling, we would zip tie the zippers. It does have a tiny pocket on the top. Not quite sure what I would use that for.

      - Next compartment for a tablet. It is padded around the sides and has mesh in the middle. This one unzips all the way around. TSA friendly design. Have not tried this out with two laptops yet so I don't know how that will go with tsa. The tablet pocket is small so maybe ipad mini size? The ipad pro would not fit. They could have designed this to be bigger. I was thinking of getting a laptop sleeve and using this compartment for my macbook air when I travel with 2 laptops.

      - main compartment: has a mini pocket for phone but I use for my airpods. Has a divider for books, papers or whatever. I actually use it for wipes. Can fit a change of clothes in a packing cube, medications, headphones, snacks and everything I need. There is a mesh zipper pouch on the top. This is great for cords or whatever.

      - top front pocket- I have a love hate relationship with this one. Easy to empty your pockets and phone into when going through tsa but a pain to get stuff back out. You have to dig around a little. I will probably need to separate things in little bags to make this pocket work for my needs. I miss having a small top pocket for things like chapstick and eye drops. Making two pockets, iphone sized and a small one for little things, would have been my ideal solution.

      - bottom front pocket: this one is fine. Big enough for epipen, inhaler, key hook, hand sanitizer, tissues, gum, some toiletries, misc stuff. Also has some loops on outer part of pocket.

      - side zipper pockets: there are small size zipper pockets on each side that are deep. These are ok. Weird shape. Can fit a small umbrella or a standard plastic water bottle. Space for other things but I don't have that many skinny long things going in a backpack. Pocket is deep so if you wanted to put money or something way down at the bottom of this pocket, this would be hard for anyone to just grab out of your bag. You can not fit a water bottle or similar item in the mesh pockets on the outside of these ones if there is stuff in the pockets.

      - mesh stretchy water bottle pockets: The pockets are a little small. These can hold a smaller sized water bottle. There is a strap to help secure. It would be better if there was a loop at the top to hook a carabiner on it, to secure a water bottle. I have lost a water bottle before out of this pocket. Sometimes I use the strap to tie a sweatshirt or raincoat to it.

      Backpack Straps: padded, thick work well. Have a few loops for whatever. Back is padded enough. Comfortable enough to carry around for a few hours.

      Overall, a good backpack. When shopping for a backpack, think of your purpose and what you want to put in it. Does it have the right sized pockets for your needs? The price was right for this one and I will use it until it breaks.

    Product Summary: SWISSGEAR 1900 ScanSmart Laptop Backpack, Fits Most 17-Inch Laptops, TSA-Friendly Lay-Flat Design, RFID Protection, and Tablet Pocket, Black, 31L, 18.5-Inch

    From SwissGear

    4.6 out of 5 stars, 28,077 ratings

    Customer reviews

    400+ bought in past week

    Price

    No featured offers available

    Other sellers

    Other sellers

    About this Item

    • Tech Backpack: Pack all your essentials in the 1900 ScanSmart 17-inch laptop backpack specifically designed to speed you through airport security by allowing laptop-in-case scanning
    • Secure Storage: This laptop backpack for men and women features an enhanced laptop compartment with zippered access for a 17-inch laptop and a padded TabletSafe tablet pocket
    • Effortless Organization: Computer bag includes a main compartment with an accordion file holder and a RFID-protected organizer compartment with a removable key/fob clip and multiple divider pockets
    • Multiple Pockets: Add-a-bag trolley strap slides over telescopic handles, 1 front and 2 side quick-access pocket secure essentials, and 2 mesh side pockets accommodate water bottles and umbrellas
    • Comfortable To Carry: Lay-flat laptop bag includes ergonomically contoured, padded shoulder straps, adjustable compression straps, airflow back padding, and a reinforced, molded top handle
    • Compartment Dimensions: Laptop compartment - 14.5" x 11" x 1.5"; Tablet Pocket Capacity - 10" x 7"; Bag volume - 31 L

    Product Description

    The SWISSGEAR 1900 is the backpack that handles the full workload. Built from 1200D polyester, it carries the laptop, the tablet, the documents, the extra clothes, and the daily essentials without compromising structure or comfort. The ScanSmart lay-flat compartment keeps laptops up to 17" in the bag through TSA screening; a dedicated TabletSafe™ pocket secures tablets up to 10" x 7"; and a document divider in the main compartment keeps paperwork flat and accessible. At 3.2 lbs empty, it carries everything without weighing you down. Organization and comfort run deeply throughout this design. The RFID-protected front compartment holds cards, a removable key/fob clip, and the small items that need to stay put. A trolley strap slides over luggage handles so the pack rides hands-free between gates. Contoured shoulder straps and an Airflow back panel manage heat and load distribution across long travel days or commutes, while compression straps stabilize the pack when it's full and a reinforced molded top handle handles the quick grabs. Backed by SWISSGEAR's 5-year limited warranty.
